annual_reviews: Performance reviews are conducted annually in December.
training_budget: $1000 per employee per year for approved courses.
promotion_cycle: Bi-annual promotion cycles in Q1 and Q3.

wellness_programs: Free gym membership and mental health support via BetterHelp.
mentorship: Opt-in mentorship program matching juniors with senior leaders.
